tours.description: End-to-end customer follow-up process: configure the follow-up levels (15-day email, 30-day letter, 60-day SMS + call activity), read the Follow-up Reports worklist, work a single customer's overdue lines, and send a reminder through the Send and Print wizard - plus the bulk Process Automatic Follow-ups run.

description_i18n.en_US: End-to-end customer follow-up process: configure the follow-up levels (15-day email, 30-day letter, 60-day SMS + call activity), read the Follow-up Reports worklist, work a single customer's overdue lines, and send a reminder through the Send and Print wizard - plus the bulk Process Automatic Follow-ups run.

steps.title: 01 - Open Accounting app
steps.content: Customer follow-ups live inside Accounting. Click the Accounting app to start.

content_i18n.en_US: Customer follow-ups live inside Accounting. Click the Accounting app to start.

steps.title: 02 - Open the Configuration menu
steps.content: Follow-up stages are set up first. Open the Configuration menu.

content_i18n.en_US: Follow-up stages are set up first. Open the Configuration menu.
content_i18n.si_LK: Follow-up stages are set up first. Open the Configuration menu.

steps.title: 03 - Open Follow-up Levels
steps.content: Under Invoicing, click Follow-up Levels. These are the reminder stages Odoo walks a customer through as an invoice ages.

content_i18n.en_US: Under Invoicing, click Follow-up Levels. These are the reminder stages Odoo walks a customer through as an invoice ages.

steps.title: 04 - Create a new follow-up level
steps.content: The list is empty on a fresh database. Click New to add the first reminder stage.

content_i18n.en_US: The list is empty on a fresh database. Click New to add the first reminder stage.
content_i18n.si_LK: The list is empty on a fresh database. Click New to add the first reminder stage.

steps.title: 05 - Name the first stage
steps.content: Type a clear description for the stage, e.g. "1st Reminder - Email". This name appears on the customer's Follow-up Level.

content_i18n.en_US: Type a clear description for the stage, e.g. "1st Reminder - Email". This name appears on the customer's Follow-up Level.

content_i18n.ta_IN: Type a clear description for the stage, e.g. "1st Reminder - Email". This name appears on the customer's Follow-up Level.

steps.title: 06 - Set the delay in days
steps.content: Enter how many days after the invoice due date this stage triggers. Enter 15 for the first reminder.

content_i18n.en_US: Enter how many days after the invoice due date this stage triggers. Enter 15 for the first reminder.
content_i18n.si_LK: Enter how many days after the invoice due date this stage triggers. Enter 15 for the first reminder.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Enter how many days after the invoice due date this stage triggers. Enter 15 for the first reminder.

steps.title: 07 - Actions: what the stage does
steps.content: ACTIONS decides how the customer is contacted at this stage. Send Email is ticked by default; Send a Letter and Send SMS Message can be added.

content_i18n.en_US: ACTIONS decides how the customer is contacted at this stage. Send Email is ticked by default; Send a Letter and Send SMS Message can be added.
content_i18n.si_LK: ACTIONS decides how the customer is contacted at this stage. Send Email is ticked by default; Send a Letter and Send SMS Message can be added.
content_i18n.ta_IN: ACTIONS decides how the customer is contacted at this stage. Send Email is ticked by default; Send a Letter and Send SMS Message can be added.

steps.title: 08 - Content Template (optional)
steps.content: Leave blank to use the standard follow-up wording, or pick an email template here to send a specific message at this stage.

content_i18n.en_US: Leave blank to use the standard follow-up wording, or pick an email template here to send a specific message at this stage.
content_i18n.si_LK: Leave blank to use the standard follow-up wording, or pick an email template here to send a specific message at this stage.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Leave blank to use the standard follow-up wording, or pick an email template here to send a specific message at this stage.

steps.title: 09 - Tick Automatic
steps.content: Tick Automatic so Odoo sends this stage on its own when the delay is reached. Leave it off if Finance wants to review each reminder before it goes out.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick Automatic so Odoo sends this stage on its own when the delay is reached. Leave it off if Finance wants to review each reminder before it goes out.

content_i18n.ta_IN: Tick Automatic so Odoo sends this stage on its own when the delay is reached. Leave it off if Finance wants to review each reminder before it goes out.

steps.title: 10 - Attach Invoices
steps.content: Keep Attach Invoices ticked so the overdue invoice PDFs travel with the reminder. Customers settle faster when the invoice is attached.

content_i18n.en_US: Keep Attach Invoices ticked so the overdue invoice PDFs travel with the reminder. Customers settle faster when the invoice is attached.

content_i18n.ta_IN: Keep Attach Invoices ticked so the overdue invoice PDFs travel with the reminder. Customers settle faster when the invoice is attached.

steps.title: 11 - Open the Activity tab
steps.content: Open the Activity tab to also raise an internal task for the credit controller when this stage fires.

content_i18n.en_US: Open the Activity tab to also raise an internal task for the credit controller when this stage fires.
content_i18n.si_LK: Open the Activity tab to also raise an internal task for the credit controller when this stage fires.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Open the Activity tab to also raise an internal task for the credit controller when this stage fires.

steps.title: 12 - Schedule Activity (optional)
steps.content: Tick Schedule Activity to create a to-do (e.g. Call) for a responsible user each time this stage is reached. Optional - leave it off for a purely automated email stage.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick Schedule Activity to create a to-do (e.g. Call) for a responsible user each time this stage is reached. Optional - leave it off for a purely automated email stage.

steps.title: 13 - Save the first stage
steps.content: Click the cloud icon to save. Stage 1 is now live.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the cloud icon to save. Stage 1 is now live.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the cloud icon to save. Stage 1 is now live.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click the cloud icon to save. Stage 1 is now live.

steps.title: 14 - Add the second stage
steps.content: Click New again. One follow-up level per escalation step - the sequence is driven purely by the number of days.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New again. One follow-up level per escalation step - the sequence is driven purely by the number of days.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click New again. One follow-up level per escalation step - the sequence is driven purely by the number of days.

steps.title: 15 - Name the second stage
steps.content: Name it "2nd Reminder - Letter". This stage escalates from an email to a printed letter.

content_i18n.en_US: Name it "2nd Reminder - Letter". This stage escalates from an email to a printed letter.
content_i18n.si_LK: Name it "2nd Reminder - Letter". This stage escalates from an email to a printed letter.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Name it "2nd Reminder - Letter". This stage escalates from an email to a printed letter.

steps.title: 16 - Set the second delay
steps.content: Enter 30. Each stage must have a longer delay than the one before it.

content_i18n.en_US: Enter 30. Each stage must have a longer delay than the one before it.
content_i18n.si_LK: Enter 30. Each stage must have a longer delay than the one before it.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Enter 30. Each stage must have a longer delay than the one before it.

steps.title: 17 - Back to the Notification tab
steps.content: Click Notification to choose the actions for this stage.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Notification to choose the actions for this stage.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Notification to choose the actions for this stage.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Notification to choose the actions for this stage.

steps.title: 18 - Tick Send a Letter
steps.content: Tick Send a Letter. At 30 days overdue the customer gets a printed reminder as well as the email.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick Send a Letter. At 30 days overdue the customer gets a printed reminder as well as the email.
content_i18n.si_LK: Tick Send a Letter. At 30 days overdue the customer gets a printed reminder as well as the email.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Tick Send a Letter. At 30 days overdue the customer gets a printed reminder as well as the email.

steps.title: 19 - Save the second stage
steps.content: Save. Automatic was left off here, so Finance reviews the 30-day letter before it goes out.

content_i18n.en_US: Save. Automatic was left off here, so Finance reviews the 30-day letter before it goes out.
content_i18n.si_LK: Save. Automatic was left off here, so Finance reviews the 30-day letter before it goes out.

steps.title: 20 - Add the final stage
steps.content: Click New once more for the final notice stage.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New once more for the final notice stage.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click New once more for the final notice stage.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click New once more for the final notice stage.

steps.title: 21 - Name the final stage
steps.content: Name it "Final Notice - SMS + Call".

content_i18n.en_US: Name it "Final Notice - SMS + Call".
content_i18n.si_LK: Name it "Final Notice - SMS + Call".
content_i18n.ta_IN: Name it "Final Notice - SMS + Call".

steps.title: 22 - Set the final delay
steps.content: Enter 60. Anything still unpaid 60 days past due reaches the last stage and stays there.

content_i18n.en_US: Enter 60. Anything still unpaid 60 days past due reaches the last stage and stays there.
content_i18n.si_LK: Enter 60. Anything still unpaid 60 days past due reaches the last stage and stays there.

steps.title: 23 - Tick Send SMS Message
steps.content: Tick Send SMS Message. SMS needs credits and a mobile number on the customer record.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick Send SMS Message. SMS needs credits and a mobile number on the customer record.
content_i18n.si_LK: Tick Send SMS Message. SMS needs credits and a mobile number on the customer record.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Tick Send SMS Message. SMS needs credits and a mobile number on the customer record.

steps.title: 24 - Open the Activity tab
steps.content: For the final notice, also raise an internal task. Open the Activity tab.

content_i18n.en_US: For the final notice, also raise an internal task. Open the Activity tab.
content_i18n.si_LK: For the final notice, also raise an internal task. Open the Activity tab.
content_i18n.ta_IN: For the final notice, also raise an internal task. Open the Activity tab.

steps.title: 25 - Tick Schedule Activity
steps.content: Tick Schedule Activity, then pick the activity type and the responsible user so a call is logged for the credit controller.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick Schedule Activity, then pick the activity type and the responsible user so a call is logged for the credit controller.
content_i18n.si_LK: Tick Schedule Activity, then pick the activity type and the responsible user so a call is logged for the credit controller.

steps.title: 26 - Choose the Activity Type
steps.content: Pick an Activity Type such as Call, and set Responsible. Odoo will create that activity on the customer when the stage fires.

content_i18n.en_US: Pick an Activity Type such as Call, and set Responsible. Odoo will create that activity on the customer when the stage fires.

steps.title: 27 - Save the final stage
steps.content: Enter a Summary for the activity (e.g. Call customer - final notice), then click the cloud icon to save. The three stages are now in place: 15 days email, 30 days letter, 60 days SMS plus a call.

content_i18n.en_US: Enter a Summary for the activity (e.g. Call customer - final notice), then click the cloud icon to save. The three stages are now in place: 15 days email, 30 days letter, 60 days SMS plus a call.

steps.title: 28 - Review the three stages
steps.content: Click the Follow-up Levels breadcrumb to see the full ladder. Configuration is done - now the day-to-day work.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Follow-up Levels breadcrumb to see the full ladder. Configuration is done - now the day-to-day work.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the Follow-up Levels breadcrumb to see the full ladder. Configuration is done - now the day-to-day work.

steps.title: 29 - Open the Customers menu
steps.content: Now the daily routine. Open the Customers menu.

content_i18n.en_US: Now the daily routine. Open the Customers menu.
content_i18n.si_LK: Now the daily routine. Open the Customers menu.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Now the daily routine. Open the Customers menu.

steps.title: 30 - Open Follow-up Reports
steps.content: Click Follow-up Reports. This is the credit control worklist - one line per customer with money outstanding.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Follow-up Reports. This is the credit control worklist - one line per customer with money outstanding.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Follow-up Reports. This is the credit control worklist - one line per customer with money outstanding.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Follow-up Reports. This is the credit control worklist - one line per customer with money outstanding.

steps.title: 31 - Read the worklist
steps.content: Follow-up Status shows who needs chasing today; Follow-up Level shows which stage each customer has reached. Next reminder is the date the next stage is due.

content_i18n.en_US: Follow-up Status shows who needs chasing today; Follow-up Level shows which stage each customer has reached. Next reminder is the date the next stage is due.
content_i18n.si_LK: Follow-up Status shows who needs chasing today; Follow-up Level shows which stage each customer has reached. Next reminder is the date the next stage is due.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Follow-up Status shows who needs chasing today; Follow-up Level shows which stage each customer has reached. Next reminder is the date the next stage is due.

steps.title: 32 - Open a customer's follow-up
steps.content: Click a customer line to open their follow-up report. This walkthrough uses Test Credit Customer, but any line on the list works the same way.

content_i18n.en_US: Click a customer line to open their follow-up report. This walkthrough uses Test Credit Customer, but any line on the list works the same way.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click a customer line to open their follow-up report. This walkthrough uses Test Credit Customer, but any line on the list works the same way.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click a customer line to open their follow-up report. This walkthrough uses Test Credit Customer, but any line on the list works the same way.

steps.title: 33 - The stage bar
steps.content: The bar at the top shows every stage you configured and highlights where this customer sits. Clicking a stage moves the customer manually.

content_i18n.en_US: The bar at the top shows every stage you configured and highlights where this customer sits. Clicking a stage moves the customer manually.
content_i18n.si_LK: The bar at the top shows every stage you configured and highlights where this customer sits. Clicking a stage moves the customer manually.
content_i18n.ta_IN: The bar at the top shows every stage you configured and highlights where this customer sits. Clicking a stage moves the customer manually.

steps.title: 34 - Exclude a line from follow-ups
steps.content: Toggle Exclude from Follow-ups on any line that is disputed, already paid or under a payment plan. Excluded lines are ignored when the stage is calculated.

content_i18n.en_US: Toggle Exclude from Follow-ups on any line that is disputed, already paid or under a payment plan. Excluded lines are ignored when the stage is calculated.

content_i18n.ta_IN: Toggle Exclude from Follow-ups on any line that is disputed, already paid or under a payment plan. Excluded lines are ignored when the stage is calculated.

steps.title: 35 - Automatic or Manual reminders
steps.content: Automatic lets Odoo follow the stage schedule for this customer. Switch to Manual for a customer you want to chase by hand, e.g. a key account under negotiation.

content_i18n.en_US: Automatic lets Odoo follow the stage schedule for this customer. Switch to Manual for a customer you want to chase by hand, e.g. a key account under negotiation.
content_i18n.si_LK: Automatic lets Odoo follow the stage schedule for this customer. Switch to Manual for a customer you want to chase by hand, e.g. a key account under negotiation.

steps.title: 36 - Next reminder date
steps.content: Next reminder is when this customer comes back onto the worklist. Push it forward if the customer has promised payment by a certain date.

content_i18n.en_US: Next reminder is when this customer comes back onto the worklist. Push it forward if the customer has promised payment by a certain date.
content_i18n.si_LK: Next reminder is when this customer comes back onto the worklist. Push it forward if the customer has promised payment by a certain date.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Next reminder is when this customer comes back onto the worklist. Push it forward if the customer has promised payment by a certain date.

steps.title: 37 - Click Follow up to send
steps.content: Click Follow up. This opens the Send and Print wizard where you choose the channels for this reminder.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Follow up. This opens the Send and Print wizard where you choose the channels for this reminder.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Follow up. This opens the Send and Print wizard where you choose the channels for this reminder.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Follow up. This opens the Send and Print wizard where you choose the channels for this reminder.

steps.title: 38 - Choose the send channels
steps.content: ACTIONS is pre-ticked from the stage the customer is on - here Email. Tick Print for a hard copy, Sms, or By post to route it through the postal service.

content_i18n.en_US: ACTIONS is pre-ticked from the stage the customer is on - here Email. Tick Print for a hard copy, Sms, or By post to route it through the postal service.
content_i18n.si_LK: ACTIONS is pre-ticked from the stage the customer is on - here Email. Tick Print for a hard copy, Sms, or By post to route it through the postal service.

steps.content: The body comes from the stage's template. Edit it here for a one-off note - e.g. reference a cheque the customer says they posted. The overdue table is added automatically.

steps.title: 40 - Attach the invoices
steps.content: Attach Invoices carries the overdue invoice PDFs with the reminder. Use Attachment below to add anything else, such as a signed delivery note.

content_i18n.en_US: Attach Invoices carries the overdue invoice PDFs with the reminder. Use Attachment below to add anything else, such as a signed delivery note.

steps.title: 41 - The Send button
steps.content: In daily use this is the button that dispatches the reminder, logs it in the chatter and moves the customer to the next stage. The label changes to Send & Print when Print is also ticked.

content_i18n.en_US: In daily use this is the button that dispatches the reminder, logs it in the chatter and moves the customer to the next stage. The label changes to Send & Print when Print is also ticked.

steps.title: 42 - Close the wizard
steps.content: For this walkthrough click Cancel to close without sending. Nothing is dispatched and the customer stays on the same stage.

content_i18n.en_US: For this walkthrough click Cancel to close without sending. Nothing is dispatched and the customer stays on the same stage.

steps.title: 44 - Select customers for a batch
steps.content: Tick the header box to select every customer on the page, or tick individual rows. This is how the monthly reminder run is done.

content_i18n.en_US: Tick the header box to select every customer on the page, or tick individual rows. This is how the monthly reminder run is done.

steps.content: With rows selected, open Actions to process the whole batch in one go.

content_i18n.en_US: With rows selected, open Actions to process the whole batch in one go.

steps.title: 46 - Process Automatic Follow-ups
steps.content: Process Automatic Follow-ups sends every due reminder for the selected customers in one run, using each customer's own stage. Send email and Send SMS Text Message above are the manual bulk alternatives.
